outputs: referring expressions for objects in images

changes_made.explanation: Removed model variants (tgt, vis, sym) as they are not distinct models but configurations of the main TRF and CC models. Simplified outputs to the most precise description.
No changes needed - metrics are correctly extracted and already in canonical form.
No LLM judges are used in this paper - only automatic metrics and human evaluation.

guideline: The annotators were instructed to rate only those parts of the expressions that refer to the type of the referential target. All items should be assigned exactly one of the following categories: Adequate, Misaligned, Omission, False.

changes_made.explanation: Normalized 'Omitted' to 'Omission' to be consistent with the paper's terminology.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The main issue was listing model variants (TRF_tgt, TRF_vis, etc.) as separate models when they are actually different configurations of the same TRF and CC models. The paper clearly addresses Referring Expression Generation (an NLG task) and uses both automatic metrics (BLEU, CIDEr) and human evaluation.
